data.title: Chargeback Velocity Pattern — Serial Dispute Filing Across Merchants with Confirmed Delivery
data.description: Detects friendly fraud chargeback abuse by identifying cardholders with 3 or more chargebacks filed within a 90-day window across different merchants where delivery was confirmed for the original transactions. Friendly fraud represents 36% of all fraud, with 337 million chargebacks projected for 2026 costing USD 15.3 billion in the US. Chargeback abuse surged 233% between Q1 and Q3 2025. The combination of multi-merchant dispute filing with contradicting delivery evidence is a high-confidence indicator of first-party chargeback abuse rather than legitimate disputes. Merchants lose USD 4.61 for every USD 1.00 of friendly fraud.

detection.condition: selection AND filter_velocity AND filter_cross_merchant AND filter_delivery

enrichment_required.source: Shipping carrier delivery confirmation (signed, GPS, photo)
Rolling 90-day dispute count per cardholder from payment network data
Rolling 90-day distinct merchant dispute count per cardholder

queries.sql:
-- SQL: Chargeback Velocity Pattern Detection
-- 3+ chargebacks in 90 days across multiple merchants with confirmed delivery
SELECT
  c.cardholder_id,
  c.cardholder_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.dispute_id) AS dispute_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.merchant_id) AS merchant_count,
  SUM(d.dispute_amount) AS total_disputed,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.delivery_confirmed = 1 THEN d.dispute_id END)
    AS confirmed_delivery_disputes,
  ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.transaction_date, d.dispute_date)), 1)
    AS avg_days_to_dispute,
  MIN(d.dispute_date) AS first_dispute,
  MAX(d.dispute_date) AS last_dispute
FROM chargebacks d
JOIN cardholders c ON d.cardholder_id = c.cardholder_id
JOIN transactions t ON d.original_transaction_id = t.transaction_id
WHERE d.dispute_date >= DATEADD(DAY, -90, CURRENT_DATE)
  AND t.delivery_confirmed = 1
GROUP BY c.cardholder_id, c.cardholder_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.dispute_id) >= 3
  AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.merchant_id) >= 2
ORDER BY dispute_count DESC
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL: Chargeback Velocity Pattern Detection")`
`comment("Identifies serial chargeback abusers across multiple merchants")`
index=flame_payments sourcetype=flame:dispute_management
  (dispute_type="chargeback" OR dispute_type="pre-arbitration")
| lookup delivery_lookup original_transaction_id OUTPUT delivery_confirmed, delivery_date
| where delivery_confirmed="true"
| stats count AS dispute_count,
        dc(merchant_id) AS merchant_count,
        sum(dispute_amount) AS total_disputed,
        min(dispute_date) AS first_dispute,
        max(dispute_date) AS last_dispute,
        values(dispute_reason_code) AS reason_codes
  BY cardholder_id, cardholder_name
| where dispute_count >= 3 AND merchant_count >= 2
| eval dispute_window_days = round((strptime(last_dispute, "%Y-%m-%d") - strptime(first_dispute, "%Y-%m-%d")) / 86400, 0)
| sort - dispute_count
queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL: Chargeback Velocity Pattern
// 3+ disputes in 90 days across 2+ merchants with delivery confirmed
dispute_type="chargeback" OR dispute_type="pre-arbitration"
delivery_confirmed="true"
| groupBy(cardholder_id, function=[
    count(as=dispute_count),
    collect([cardholder_name, dispute_amount, merchant_id, dispute_reason_code]),
    countDistinct(field=merchant_id, as=merchant_count),
    sum(field=dispute_amount, as=total_disputed)
  ])
| dispute_count >= 3
| merchant_count >= 2
| sort(dispute_count, order=desc)

references: Chargebacks911, State of Chargebacks 2026 — 337M projection, USD 15.3B impact
Chargeflow, Friendly Fraud Statistics 2025 — 233% surge, 84% simplicity preference
Payscout, The True Cost of Chargebacks (2025) — USD 4.61 multiplier
Chargeback.io, Chargeback Industry Trends 2026 — 36% of all fraud
falsepositives: Cardholders who are genuine victims of multiple merchant fraud incidents
Cardholders disputing recurring subscription charges from multiple services
Shared household cards where multiple family members file independent disputes
